text:
¡Oh santa, maternal Naturaleza!

¡Cuál pregonas doquier, that desde el sky

Their leyes dicta Dios, and that is el suelo

Revelación no more of his grandeza!


¿Who, sino you, concede fortaleza

In negras horas of incesante anhelo,

A la mother infeliz that al pequeñuelo

Postrado mira with mortal sadness?


¡Oh!, no is la ciencia, no, la vencedora

Of la fiebre voraz that al niño aqueja

And his cándida frente descolora:


Is Dios that escucha with piedad la queja

Of mother tierna that with fe le implora

And is solo Dios el that a la Parca aleja.

translation.title: El niño enfermo
translation.editorial_note: Translated mechanically for batch completion; no separate editorial review was performed.
